title: Tiny, cute helicopter
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- rotor blade -->
  <rect x='12' y='22' width='76' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#9fd8ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='24.5' r='4' fill='#7ec8f0'/>
  <!-- mast -->
  <rect x='47' y='27' width='6' height='8' fill='#78b8d8'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='30' ry='20' fill='#ffcf4d'/>
  <!-- body shading -->
  <path d='M50 75 a30 20 0 0 0 30 -20 a30 20 0 0 1 -30 20 z' fill='#f0b32e' transform='translate(0,-0)'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='47' rx='16' ry='8' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <!-- tail boom -->
  <rect x='76' y='50' width='16' height='6' rx='3' fill='#e9b73a'/>
  <!-- tail fin -->
  <path d='M90 50 L96 44 L96 58 Z' fill='#ff8a5c'/>
  <!-- tail rotor -->
  <circle cx='93' cy='51' r='2' fill='#9fd8ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='93' cy='51' rx='1.4' ry='6' fill='#cdeaff'/>
  <!-- skids -->
  <rect x='32' y='76' width='36' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7ec8f0'/>
  <rect x='38' y='72' width='4' height='6' fill='#78b8d8'/>
  <rect x='58' y='72' width='4' height='6' fill='#78b8d8'/>
  <!-- cockpit window -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='52' rx='11' ry='10' fill='#8fe0ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='49' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#d8f6ff'/>
  <!-- cute details: pink cheek -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='62' r='4' fill='#ff9ab0'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M40 64 q6 6 12 0' stroke='#b07020' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
